signed_deviations: Reuse persisted, rounded calib_delta_*; zeros are neutral/rounding-ambiguous. No raw-feature quality direction is assumed.
warning_contract: Frozen production operating threshold; authoritative warning builder, censoring, and one-to-one matcher; exact persisted-alert identity parity.
directional_primary_unit: Evaluable unmatched warning STARTS on outings with zero labeled episodes. Flagged-run pitches are secondary and never counted as independent warnings.
directional_comparators: all eligible pitches reweighted to warning-start pitcher, pitch type, dominant feature, and 10-pitch workload band
dispersion_primary_population: Available post-calibration train scores with y_true_onset_in_horizon == False; this is non-pre-onset, not proof of physiological in-control state.
dispersion_strict_sensitivity: Additionally exclude active episodes and right-censored follow-up.
conditional_next_step: Evaluate a fixed train-fitted scale candidate on development data if dispersion gate passes; production integration requires evidence of incremental benefit. Directional production scoring requires its confound gate first.
scientific_corrections: Higher spin is pitch-type dependent; sign labels are hypotheses, not fatigue diagnoses.
A whitened-coordinate coefficient mixes original features; raw directional checks require mapping back through each whitening transform.
Global CUSUM reference mean is not calibrated by in-game feature-mean shrinkage.
Train-fitted parameters cannot be applied retrospectively to earlier train outings as causal scores.
Adding config/source changes necessarily creates a new protocol hash; numeric default parity is the valid guard, not byte-identical manifests.
prior_exposure_disclosure: Exploratory 2025 metrics were generated in this workspace before this revised protocol. The current result is therefore a locked retrospective holdout evaluation, not a pristine first look.
